name: Black Mountain Online
summary:
Black Mountain Online is an isometric dark-fantasy action RPG set in the Forsaken Vale. Players choose from five classes - Warrior, Rogue, Hunter, Mage, or Cleric - and explore Ashen Camp, Deadwood, the Forgotten Graveyard, and the Black Crypt .

The game features real-time combat, class-specific skills, quests, world events, equipment, loot, character progression, and online cooperative play for up to eight players. Act I culminates in a confrontation with the Grave Warden.
